d: A fatal structural failure occurred in Old Delhi's Gali Sattara near Chawri Bazaar Metro Station on Thursday morning when a three-storey under-construction building collapsed, claiming two lives and leaving workers injured and feared trapped beneath rubble. Emergency distress calls prompted rapid deployment of Delhi Fire Services, National Disaster Response Force, and local police teams to execute rescue operations alongside local residents. Preliminary findings indicate load-bearing framework failure on a small fifty-square-yard plot following rapid construction. Local representatives…
